author: Porkyyy
body:
Before Avicore, the XP bar in-game would alllow you to see exactly how much XP you have, and how much you need before you level up.

This was very helpful for me, because I always like having a visual on how much XP I am gaining, and how it is increasing my overall XP for that certain gamemode.

Some players may not care about this, but I think that it was very useful.

I would like to see this being re-implemented, so that we may closer examine our XP, which is overall just helpful for many players.

Opinions?
